title: Integrate INT8 weight-only profiles with stochastic calibration & cross-variant regression suite
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Context:
We need to onboard INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ/AWQ) into the runtime staging fleet and add a deterministic, stochastic, and adversarial regression harness to validate accuracy and numerical stability across kernels, sequence-length distributions, and prefix-caching interactions. Current integration attempts revealed edge cases in mixed-seqlen micro-batching and subtle answer-drift when kernel swap occurs under low-latency settings.

Goal:
1) Integrate profile ingestion, pinning, and model-variant routing for INT8 weight-only profiles into the staging pipeline.
2) Implement a cross-variant regression suite that includes: deterministic golden-eval, monte-carlo stochastic calibration runs, kernel-swap fuzzing, and adversarial prompt stress-tests.
3) Define quantitative acceptance criteria for rollout and automatic rollback thresholds.

Success criteria (must be automated):
- Golden-answer delta: median token-level edit distance <= 0.6% across the curated prompt set for each model family (GPT-style, Llama-style).
- Perplexity/LL loss: no model family regression > 0.8% relative to float baseline on evaluation corpus.
- Stability under kernel swap: no increase in error rate (F1/EM as applicable) > 1.2x during injected kernel swap events.
- Latency SLO: P50 token latency degradation <= 10% versus baseline when running INT8 profile.
- Telemetry: new signals available for profile-version, kernel-id, seqlen-bucket, batch-size, and kv-cache-hits.

Planned work (implementation milestones):
- Ingest & metadata: support profile manifest v2 (profile-id, model-commit, quant-backend, numeric-stats). (owner: Liam)
- Serving plumbing: routing by pinned-profile with compatibility fallback to float/FP8 variants. Add metric tags for profile-version and fallback-reasons. (owner: Runtime Eng)
- Stochastic calibration harness: implement Monte-Carlo temperature/seed sweep to detect brittle quantization boundaries; run nightly with synthetic perturbations. (owner: Calibration Team)
- Cross-variant regression: build a CI job that runs golden-eval, stochastic runs, kernel-swap chaos injection, and includes adversarial prompt set from Eval Team. (owner: CI Eng)
- Dashboards & Alerts: per-profile health dashboard and alert rules for "golden-delta" and "regression-signal". (owner: Observability)
- Canary plan: shadow → 1% canary (no fallback) → 10% canary (fallback enabled) → 50% ramp. Rollback triggers listed below.

Testing matrix (examples):
- Models: redwood/gpt-medium, open/llama-3-13b, community/meta-7b-adapted (placeholders).
- Seq lengths: 32, 128, 512, 2048; mixed-seqlen micro-batch scenarios.
- Hardware: A100-80GB (fp16 baseline), A10x, T4-equivalent; CPU inference sanity.
- Kernels: default fused-attn, seq-aware kernel, and legacy kernel-swapped path.

Rollback / safety triggers:
- Golden-answer median edit distance breach > 1.0% for any model family over a 2k sample window.
- Repeated fallback rate > 5% for 1h window (indicates compatibility problems).
- Latency P95 increase > 25% sustained for 30m.
- Any security incident or data-exposure alert.

Artifacts & links:
- Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/INT8+Profile+Integration+Design
- Eval corpus & adversarial set: https://drive.redwood.com/quant/evals/int8-adversarial-2025
- PR (serving): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821
- PR (ci): https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci/pull/1197
- Dashboard (staging): https://grafana.redwood.com/d/quant/int8-profile-health

Notes on scope & tradeoffs:
- We will prioritize weight-only INT8 (GPTQ/AWQ) for common model shapes first; per-layer mixed-precision is out-of-scope for this ticket.
- Because stochastic calibration can surface nondeterministic failures, we will gate production rollout on deterministic golden-eval plus a nightly stability window.

Deliverables:
- Ingest + metadata schema change merged
- Serving routing + metric tagging merged
- CI regression job and nightly stochastic calibration job enabled
- Dashboard and alerting rules created
- Canary run executed and roll forward or rollback decision documented
